fee_notes: Royalty of 5.5% of Gross Revenues payable semi-monthly (by the 20th and 5th of each month). Advertising and Development Fund contribution of 1% of Gross Revenues, plus franchisee must spend at least 2% of gross revenues on local advertising. MACA (Marketing and Advertising Coverage Area) payments capped at $4,000/year. Centralized Buying Service Fee: $1,000/month (while participating). Inventory Management Service Fee: $600/month (when not participating in Centralized Buying Service after opening). Option fee: $15,000 (if purchasing a location option). Transfer Fee: $30,000. Late fee: $5/day per late payment or report. Finance charge: lower of 18% or highest legal rate. Liquidated damages up to 36 months of prior royalty payments on premature termination. No disclosed technology fee line item.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty Payments | 5.5% of Gross Revenues(2) | Payable semi-monthly by the 20th and the 5th of each month. | Based on Gross Revenues for the preceding period of the 1st through the 15th for payments on the 20th, and the 16th through the last day of the month for payments on the 5th.
Option fee | $15,000 | Payable on signing the Location Option Agreement | Payable if you purchase an option (See Item 12)
Advertising and Development Fund (3) | 1% of your Gross Revenues | Payable to the Advertising and Development Fund in same manner as Royalty Fee listed above. | You also have to spend at least 2% of gross revenues on local advertising. See Item 11 for a detailed discussion about the Advertising and Development Fund.
Marketing and Advertising Coverage Area ("MACA") Payments | Your share of the advertising expense for your MACA not to exceed $4,000 a year | Payable directly to the supplier or to COUNTRY VISIONS as invoiced | The MACA is described in Item 11 of this Disclosure Document. It is not a formal advertising cooperative and has no standing membership, governing body or voting rights.
Centralized Buying Service Fee | $1,000 per month | Payable semi-monthly by the 20th and the 5th of each month. | Payable so long as FRANCHISEE's participation in the Centralized Buying Service is in effect
Inventory Management Service Fee | $600 per month | Payable semi-monthly by the 20th and the 5th of each month. | Payable during any period of time when FRANCHISEE's participation in the Centralized Buying Service is not in effect after opening
Centralized Buying Service or Inventory Management Service Termination Fee | The applicable monthly fee for the relevant service multiplied by the remaining number of months in the calendar year plus 1 month | Upon demand | Payable only if you terminate the Centralized Buying Service or the Inventory Management Service without our prior approval
Late Fees | $5 per day for each day the Royalty or other payment or reports are late | On demand
Finance Charge | Lower of 18% or highest legal rate for open account business credit accrued from due date | On demand after due dates of late payment
Transfer Fee | $30,000 | Prior to transfer of the franchise or a controlling interest in it
Field Visits | Cover our travel and expenses only. | As incurred if provided at your request
Relocation | Reasonable costs we incur | As incurred
Audit | Cost of an inspection or audit | As incurred
Insurance | Premiums for required insurance and our costs and expenses | On demand
Indemnification | Cost of defending and indemnifying COUNTRY VISIONS if claims are made against us because of your franchised operations | As incurred
Liquidated Damages | Varies based on unexpired term of your franchise agreement. Maximum is amount equal to prior 36 months of Royalty payments. | Upon your premature termination or discontinuance of operation as our franchisee.
